messages:
zoe: Heads-up 0: nightly NetSuite import rejected ~19 EUR invoices with a currency/subsidiary mismatch. Finance reconciliation flagged them.

zoe: Error excerpt:
```
NetSuite::ValidationError: currency 'EUR' not allowed for subsidiary 'US-SALES' invoice_id=inv_EU12ab
```

zoe: These invoices were created by a EU pricing experiment that minted invoices in EUR. Our transform currently sets subsidiary based on customer.region assuming currency follows region, but some test accounts have EUR currency with US subsidiary.

nina: So customers charged by Stripe in EUR succeeded, but NS import fails and AR stays out of sync. How many affected?

zoe: 19 invoices across 7 customers. None posted to NetSuite. I moved the staging CSVs to quarantine to avoid partial posts.

ops-jen: @billing-bot open a ticket and assign to eng + finance for mapping rules + backfill plan.

billing-bot: Created FIN-5312: "Currency vs subsidiary mismatch on NS import -> validation + audit" assigned to @daniel, priority P2, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5312

daniel: Quick analysis: transform currently picks subsidiary = region_map[customer.region] and currency = invoice.currency. We need a validation step: if currency not in allowed_currencies_for(subsidiary) then (a) attempt to map subsidiary by currency override OR (b) route to quarantine and write full payload to audit S3 for manual review.

nina: Finance preference: do NOT auto-move subsidiary for money-moving records without manual review. Option (b) preferred: write audit blob and set a soft-fail so we can review then re-run with approved subsidiary.

daniel: Plan: (1) add validation in transform that checks allowed currencies per subsidiary; on mismatch -> set net_suite_action="quarantine" and write payload to s3://redwood-billing/audit/currency_mismatch/{invoice_id}.json (60d lifecycle, finance+eng ACL) (2) surface a `finance_quarantine_{date}.csv` with invoice_id, customer_id, amount, currency, assumed_subsidiary, reason (3) add a small admin UI + an API endpoint for finance to approve a subsidiary override per invoice for backfill. ETA: I can get the validation + audit write in today, admin UI is a follow-up.

zoe: Backfill: please generate the CSV and hold reprocessing until finance reviews. We need a definitive list before month-end close.

ops-jen: SRE note: disabling auto-retries for quarantine errors to avoid churn. Also add an alert when >5 quarantine events occur in a day.

daniel: I'll open a PR that implements the validation and audit write. For now I'll add a polite memo in the audit blob explaining why we quarantined. Will tag FIN-5312 with the PR link.

billing-bot: FIN-5312 updated: comment from @daniel with PR link https://git.redwood.ai/billing/commit/currency-validate and `finance_quarantine_2026-03-23.csv` uploaded to the ticket.

nina: Finance will review the CSV and decide subsidiary overrides case-by-case. Please ensure the CSV includes experiment_id and stripe_invoice_id for our traceability.

zoe: Current status: 19 invoices quarantined, staging CSVs moved. I'll attach logs and sample audit blob to FIN-5312. Will wait for finance sign-off before backfill. :thumbsup:
